name: target-script
description: Unofficial language support for the Thrustmaster T.A.R.G.E.T. HOTAS scripting language (.tmc, .tmh, .ttm): syntax highlighting, device-aware completion, hover docs, outline and diagnostics.

targetScript.installPath.markdownDescription: Path to the TARGET installation's `scripts` folder (the one containing `target.tmh`). Leave empty to auto-detect. Used to resolve `include "target.tmh"`, and to locate `TARGETGUI.exe` and `Interpreter.exe` for the compile and run commands.

targetScript.diagnostics.enable.description: Enable diagnostics (arity checks, EXEC restrictions, range checks, DirectX limits).

targetScript.bindsFolder.markdownDescription: Folder to search for game binding files: Elite Dangerous `.binds`, DCS World `.diff.lua`, or Star Citizen ActionMaps `.xml`. Leave empty to search beside the script, one level up, and in the workspace root.

targetScript.diagnostics.unboundKeys.markdownDescription: Report keys the game's current bindings do nothing with, as Information in the Problems panel. Off by default: the answer depends on which preset the game has loaded and which binding files are on this machine, so the same project reports differently elsewhere.

commands.title: Show Where This Key Is Bound

scripts.gen: node tools/gen-builtins.mjs && node tools/gen-grammar.mjs && node tools/gen-device-labels.mjs && node tools/gen-usb-codes.mjs
scripts.test: npm run compile && node test/run-grammar-test.mjs && node test/run-diagnostics-test.mjs && node test/run-provider-test.mjs && node test/run-include-test.mjs && node test/run-command-test.mjs && node test/run-runner-test.mjs

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Compiling and running a script executes the TARGET tools against files in the workspace, so those commands are unavailable in an untrusted workspace. Highlighting, completion, hover and diagnostics work normally.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Highlighting, snippets and the editor configuration work in a virtual workspace. Diagnostics, include resolution, compiling and running need the files on a local disk and are unavailable.
